name: Joshua Tree National Park
about: Oct–Apr is the comfortable window for hiking and climbing, summer regularly tops 100°F.
overview: High Mojave desert meets low Colorado desert — otherworldly yucca-tree silhouettes, boulder fields, and some of the darkest skies in Southern California.
costOverview: Prices stay close to typical national-park levels — the real splurge here is a guided stargazing tour, since Joshua Tree's dark skies are one of its biggest draws.

specialSeasons.text: Wildflowers can bloom across the desert floor in good rain years — timing and intensity vary a lot year to year.
